title: SourceArtifact
description: Input to generate() — one source (or bundle of sources concatenated for a single prompt invocation) plus the requested audience. Identifier convention follows OpenLineage's namespace + name scheme, expressed as a single URI.

uri.description: Identifier for the source. Examples: file:///data/anonymized/CS-06.md (thesis single-file), bundle:///CS-06.md,CS-07.md (thesis multi-file), sharepoint://.../doc.docx (production).

content_hash.description: sha256 hex of the source content as fed to the LLM. Prefixed with 'sha256:' so the algorithm is self-describing.

content.description: Source content as fed to the LLM. For multi-file bundles, the concatenation that the prompt actually saw.

audience.description: Target audience for the generated entry (CL-01, thesis §4.2.3). Must match one of the audiences declared in the prompt YAML.
